The '''Four Hundred and Third''', often referred to as the '''Four Hundred Third''', was a military unit of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|army]] during and after the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="Deceived" />

The 403rd enjoyed an impressive reputation in the Empire, so much that a naval officer such as [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Jard]] of the ''[[Valor (Sith cruiser)|Valor]]'' recognized the designation immediately, and the mention of their name impressed a squad of Imperial Army [[Imperial soldier|troopers]].<ref name="Deceived" />

The 403rd, or at least its component [[Company E]], was associated with the [[Imperial sniper corps]].<ref name="Deceived" /> The assassin [[Vrath Xizor]] claimed to have once been a sniper from Company E of the 403rd, serving detached as a marksman with other units.<ref name="Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 403rd is only referred to in the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', where its name is always given longform as "Four Hundred and Third" or "Four Hundred Third". The numerical form '''403rd''' is never used, and is thus not strictly [[canon]].

Presumably, the designation is an abbreviated one, but no longer title for the unit is stated in the novel, and it is unknown whether they are a large formation such as a [[Division/Legends|division]] or a smaller one like a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]]. Similarly although Vrath Xizor claims to be a veteran of both the 403rd and the [[Imperial sniper corps]], the exact relationship between the two designations is not explained.
